notes.title: Setting Kyklos Code free
notes.notes:
Good news everybody! We decided to set Kyklos Code free (as in not paid). It has been our first game as a studio and roughly 2 years after its release it has reached the end of sales for us. Within the next weeks its price will change to free and everyone can try to beat the evil virus.
Have fun!
